method: exact integer Gram principal minors and cup-free characters
dimension_condition: integer D >= 8 (in fact polynomial checks hold for real D >= 8)
wire_order: input0, output1, input2, output3; unnormalized channel Choi matrices
tester_constraints: 0 <= T_s <= T1_012 tensor I_3; Tr_2 T1 = rho_0 tensor I_1; Tr rho_0 = 1
correct_dual: H >= Delta, H >= 0; Tr_3 H = Z_01 tensor I_2; Tr_1 Z = kappa I_0
H: P + Delta/2 for upper bias, P - Delta/2 for lower bias
ZDelta: (I_01/D - Q01)/(D^2-1) for first/double erasure; zero for second erasure
Z: ZP +/- ZDelta/2, with the same sign as H
